Hi, I'm Shai. Most people
know me as FindShai.

Content creator Dubai based Marketing pro Hidden gems Real reactions
"

By profession, I'm a marketing professional. By heart, I'm the friend who always has her phone out because "wait, this moment is cute".


I'm usually behind the camera, talking to the staff, asking about their story. I don't do big reviews or perfect scripts. I film what it feels like to be there, so when you watch it, you feel like you were there too.


What I love filming: small cafés, neighborhood spots, people who make things with their hands, FMCG brands still finding their voice, events and pop-ups worth attending. Places, products, and experiences that deserve to be found. Not just food. Anything with a story worth telling.


99% of every video's viewers have never followed the account. That's not the algorithm being generous. That's what happens when the story is actually good.


If we align, I'd love to get to know more about you.

What FindShai creates

Simple to start. Real to watch.

UGC, discovery content, and mini series. Food, products, events, experiences. If your brand has a feeling, FindShai can film it.

01
One visit, one story

Discovery Video

I come by, chat with your team, film what it feels like to be there. One Reel you can use and I can share. Natural, not an ad.

  • 1 short-form video, IG and TikTok
  • Big captions for silent watching
  • 1-2 revisions included
  • Organic posting, additional for raw files

Best for cafés, restaurants, small spots wanting footfall.

Turnaround 3-5 days · Revisions 1-2 included · Usage we agree upfront

02
For launches and menus

Mini Series

3-5 videos as a little series so people remember you, not just scroll. Different hooks, same warm feel.

  • 3-5 short videos
  • Hook ideas and story flow included
  • 1-2 revisions per video
  • Cross-post IG and TikTok

Good for new branches, new menu, seasonal. Concept help at no extra charge.

Turnaround 3-5 days · Revisions 1-2 per video · Scope-based pricing

You post it, no following needed

UGC for Your Page

You need videos for your own page or ads that don't feel like ads. I film them, you post them. No need to be on my feed.
